name: Nigerian jollof rice with chicken
steps: Blend the tinned tomatoes, red pepper, onion, and scotch bonnet into a smooth base.
Fry the tomato blend in oil with tomato puree until reduced and darkened.
Stir in curry powder, thyme, a stock cube, and a splash of water.
Add the rinsed rice, stir to coat, cover, and simmer until tender.
Pan-sear the diced chicken breast until browned and cooked through.
Fold the chicken through the rice and rest for a few minutes before serving.
